title: Theme D | Evidence Lab
primerChecklist: I understand that I must verify answers against original sources, not just the Gem response.
I know where to add a screenshot and how to check its size in the report.
I understand that local drafts are not stored in Moodle, Google Drive or OneDrive.
I know how to download a backup if I need to stop before finishing.
I will complete one level, download and open its PDF, then submit that level in Moodle.

levels.title: Technical practice
levels.description: A short rehearsal of the reporting tool. No Gem is needed. Try one question, add an image and download a practice PDF. This is not assessed and must not be submitted.

screenshots.title: Your practice screenshot
screenshots.help: Take a screenshot of the practice source below, or use the dummy image button. Do not include private information.

screenshots.title: Optional second screenshot
screenshots.help: You may try the second image slot too. It is optional in the primer.

questions.label: Practice opening time
questions.question: At what time does the practice help desk open on weekdays?

example.answer: It opens at 09:00 on weekdays.

levels.improvementPrompt: What did you try in this practice?
levels.reflectionPrompt: What will you check before submitting a real report?
levels.exampleImprovement: I checked the short practice source and added a screenshot.
levels.exampleReflection: I can add evidence, download a PDF and check that the text and image are readable.
levels.practiceSource: PRACTICE-01: The practice help desk opens at 09:00 on weekdays. This invented sentence is only for testing the reporting tool.

levels.title: Build your assistant
levels.description: Pilot only: test the form for a policy-based Gem. The questions below are examples, not the final assessed assignment.

screenshots.title: Your Gem instructions
screenshots.help: Show the source rules and what the assistant should do when information is missing. Use a wide, readable crop.

screenshots.title: Your knowledge and a test
screenshots.help: Show the attached policy or a relevant test answer. The final screenshot brief will be set with the real materials.

questions.label: Service area
questions.question: Which area does the sample service cover?

example.answer: The sample service covers mainland Finland.

questions.label: Reference number
questions.question: What reference should the employee ask for first?

example.answer: Ask for the order ID before checking a specific order.

questions.label: Estimated date
questions.question: Is an estimated delivery date a guaranteed promise?

example.answer: No. It is an estimate, not a guaranteed appointment.

questions.label: Approval boundary
questions.question: Can the assistant approve a special exception?

example.answer: No. A responsible employee must approve an exception.

questions.label: Missing information
questions.question: What should the assistant do when its sources do not support an answer?

example.answer: State the gap and ask for clarification or human review.

levels.improvementPrompt: What did you check or improve?
levels.reflectionPrompt: What did you learn, and what still needs human judgement?
levels.exampleImprovement: Q03 missed the difference between an estimate and a promise. I clarified the instruction and repeated the test.
levels.exampleReflection: A clear answer is not enough. I still need to read the original policy and check the conditions.

levels.title: Build your FAQ
levels.description: Pilot only: practise reporting an FAQ created from emails and calls. Verify against the original conversations, not just your rewritten FAQ.

screenshots.title: Your FAQ with original references
screenshots.help: Show one or two FAQ entries and the original email or call IDs behind them.

screenshots.title: A response using the new knowledge
screenshots.help: Show a relevant Gem answer after adding your FAQ.

questions.label: Address change
questions.question: What information is needed to request an address change after dispatch?

example.answer: Collect the order ID and new address; Operations must approve.
example.fix: Added the approval condition to the FAQ.

questions.label: Damaged item
questions.question: What evidence should a customer prepare for a damaged item?

example.answer: Order ID, description and photos of the item and packaging.

questions.label: Missed delivery
questions.question: What is the first check after a missed delivery?

example.answer: Read the delivery notification and check the recorded status.

questions.label: Another collector
questions.question: What must be checked when another person collects an order?

example.answer: Check the order reference and the recorded collection authority.

questions.label: No reference
questions.question: What should staff do when the caller cannot find the order ID?

example.answer: Collect the approved lookup details and ask Customer Service.

levels.improvementPrompt: What did you check or improve?
levels.reflectionPrompt: What did you learn, and what still needs human judgement?
levels.exampleImprovement: I grouped repeated questions and kept the original source IDs. Q01 needed an extra approval condition from a call.
levels.exampleReflection: The FAQ is a useful access point, but its summary must not remove exceptions or replace original evidence.

levels.title: Add changing information
levels.description: Pilot only: record five checks of existing orders. Try an update separately. A failed automatic refresh does not block the report.

screenshots.title: The updated source record
screenshots.help: Show the added or changed record with its ID and the changed field. The fixed test records should stay unchanged.

screenshots.title: The response to your update test
screenshots.help: Show what the Gem actually returned, including an outdated answer or a no-information response.

questions.label: Order destination
questions.question: Where is sample order ORD-1042 going?

example.answer: The destination is Tampere.

questions.label: Current status
questions.question: What is the recorded status of ORD-1045?

example.answer: The recorded status is In transit.

questions.label: Delivery estimate
questions.question: What is the expected date for ORD-1048, and is it guaranteed?

example.answer: 30 September 2026; the date is an estimate, not a promise.

questions.label: Last update
questions.question: When was ORD-1050 last updated?

example.answer: 28 September 2026 at 08:30.

questions.label: Awaiting collection
questions.question: What does the status of ORD-1052 mean?

example.answer: It is ready for collection; follow the collection notification.

levels.improvementPrompt: What did you check or improve?
levels.reflectionPrompt: What did you learn, and what still needs human judgement?
levels.exampleImprovement: I added ORD-9001 and changed its status to Ready for collection. I kept the original test records unchanged.
levels.exampleReflection: The source changed, but the Gem did not find it in my test. I documented this instead of claiming automatic refresh.

levels.title: Update and improve
levels.description: Pilot only: return to less-common evidence, apply a management decision and add a register field. Earlier test topics do not depend on the changed rule.

screenshots.title: The source changes you made
screenshots.help: Show a clear change to the FAQ, policy or register. Use a caption to identify the evidence.

screenshots.title: Your retest result
screenshots.help: Show a response after the change. An unsuccessful source-update experiment is valid evidence too.

questions.label: Less-common situation
questions.question: What should staff do when only one box of a two-box order arrives?

example.answer: Check both package references before reporting the missing box.
example.fix: Added the two-box exception to the FAQ.

questions.label: Several references
questions.question: How should staff handle a caller with two different references?

example.answer: Identify which reference belongs to each order before replying.

questions.label: New return window
questions.question: Which return-request window now applies under the new management decision?

example.answer: The sample decision changes the request window to 21 days.

questions.label: New register field
questions.question: Who is recorded as the collection contact for ORD-1060?

example.answer: The Gem did not find the new collection contact in this attempt.
example.fix: Checked the source edit and recorded the refresh limitation.

questions.label: Unchanged rule
questions.question: After the changes, which area does the service still cover?

example.answer: The service still covers mainland Finland.

levels.improvementPrompt: What did you check or improve?
levels.reflectionPrompt: What did you learn, and what still needs human judgement?
levels.exampleImprovement: I added a less-common FAQ entry, applied M01 and created CollectionContact for the specified orders. I retested the unchanged service scope.
levels.exampleReflection: I need to keep the FAQ, policy and register consistent. The source-update test is an observation, not a guaranteed live connection.
